text_to_image_prompt: 生成一张完整的场景设定图板，画幅 1024×1536。两列三行明亮写实美国海滨高中剧场景板：雨窗旁广播站、橙色台灯、磁带、调音台与波形屏幕；雨后棒球场与海湾；奶油白自助洗衣店；雨中海湾玻璃公交站；日光档案室；旧金属广播塔内部步道。奶油白、浅灰、暖木色、低饱和蓝绿，柔和自然光、低对比、真实材质与微弱胶片光晕，保持真实欧美高中生活感，无人和可读文字。
original_prompt: Create a bright high-key scene design board for the original live-action teen drama After the Ninth Inning, six cinematic location panels in a clean 2 by 3 grid, no people and no readable text. Locations: 1) high-school radio station with orange desk lamp, analog mixer, cassette tapes and waveform monitor, daylight through rain window; 2) coastal American high-school baseball field after rain, wet grass, white chalk lines, tall floodlights but bright soft overcast sky; 3) warm neighborhood laundromat with cream walls, silver washer doors, soft daylight and a back door; 4) glass bus stop by a harbor road with pale blue-gray rain and warm streetlight; 5) school archive room with pale fluorescent light, glass cabinets, folders and a long table; 6) old broadcast tower interior with pale storm light, clean steel beams and visible cable lines, no horror mood. Unified visual language: photorealistic live-action teen drama production design, bright pale cream, warm gray and muted blue-gray, soft frontal light, natural materials, subtle cinematic diffusion, low contrast, tactile detail, vertical-friendly compositions, no dark blue-black grading, no teal-orange, no HDR, no logos, no people, no text, no illustration, no 3D render.
